ui.introWhat: Schnellbild is a free Mac app for the pictures and videos in your folders: open a folder and its thumbnails are there, one key shows a picture large. It plays MKV, AVI and WebM, opens ZIP and RAR archives like folders, and works without an account and without network access.
ui.kindImage: Schnellbild opens a folder straight away, with nothing to import, and you page through its pictures with the arrow keys: HEIC, RAW, PSD, animated GIF and PDF included, with the folder's videos in the same grid.
ui.kindVideo: Schnellbild isn't a full media player. It shows the videos of a folder as thumbnails next to the photos, plays MKV, AVI and WebM, and the arrow keys skim through a video a tenth at a time.
ui.kindComic: Schnellbild opens CBZ, CBR, ZIP, RAR and 7z like folders, without unpacking anything to disk, and you page through them with the arrow keys.
ui.kindFiles: Schnellbild isn't a file manager. It is a viewer with two panes: F5 copies and F6 moves the marked pictures into the other pane, and both can be undone.
ui.kindPhotos: Schnellbild has no library: it shows the photos and videos where they lie on disk, with the date taken and the place from their metadata, and nothing is uploaded.

yacreader.name: YACReader
yacreader.summary: YACReader is a comic reader plus a library manager (YACReaderLibrary) for large collections, with Comic Vine metadata, reading lists and a home server for its mobile apps. The reader offers double-page, manga and continuous scroll modes with image adjustments.
wins: Full comic library: Comic Vine metadata, reading lists, smart lists, ratings
Server and iOS/Android apps with synced reading progress
Manga mode, double page, continuous scroll for webtoons
Brightness/contrast/gamma for old scans
12 themes plus theme editor; reassignable shortcuts
Windows and Linux versions
yacreader.price: Desktop and server free (donations); iOS/Android apps separate
yacreader.platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, Docker/server

notes.languages_20: 14 languages (de, en, es, fr, it, ko, nl, pt, pt-PT, ru, tr, zh-CN, zh-HK, zh-TW), selectable in app
